integrity: Proof is analytical. Finite exact rank computations independently corroborate small cases and a genuine exceptional conductance, but do not constitute an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric combinatorial Laplacian, one scalar vertex input, one positive defective spoke, common positive weights otherwise; finite exceptional weight sets supplied algorithmically by resolvent polynomial roots, not universal radicals; unindexed equivalent literature may exist.
title: One pendant-edge defect and arithmetic single-site controllability of weighted sunlet graphs
